english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for indoctrination that pressures people to abandon their beliefs.

exampleSentences.english: That cult used threats and isolation for the brainwashing of its followers.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰個邪教用恐嚇同隔離嚟洗腦啲信徒。
